subject: Next steps: 30m product preview — stakeholder windows & availability constraints
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Chen <elaine@nimblehealth.com>, Ryan Smith <ryan.smith@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps: 30m product preview — stakeholder windows & availability constraints

Thanks again for the time today, Elaine and Ryan — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next step: schedule a 30-minute product preview that focuses on how Redwood Inference would fit into NimbleHealth's ML pipeline and data controls.

High-level goals for the preview (we can tweak):
- 20 min: walkthrough of the hosted + private deployment options and performance profiles
- 5 min: sample prompts / integration surface (API + SDK)
- 5 min: immediate next steps and success criteria

Three candidate windows (all in Pacific Time; please tell us if you prefer a different zone):
1) Tue Jul 2, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Wed Jul 3, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Thu Jul 4, 11:30–12:00 PM PT (short window but works for our SE)

Please let us know: which of the above works, who from your side should join (technical lead + security person recommended), and whether you want any pre-demo materials. I attached a short agenda for the preview.

If any of these are tight, tell us a couple of 30-min ranges that do work and we'll flex.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: Demo_Intro_Agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Elaine Chen <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ryan Smith <ryan.smith@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30m product preview — stakeholder windows & availability constraints

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the clear recap. The team liked the scope. We can do option 2 (Wed Jul 3, 2:00–2:30 PM PT).

Attendees from our side:
- Elaine Chen — Product, will run the session
- Ryan Smith — Engineering manager (API/infra)
- Maria Gonzalez — InfoSec (she asked to be looped in for SOC2 / data handling discussion)

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can you share the SOC 2 report or a short summary of data residency/retention defaults? Maria will want to see that before the preview.
2) If possible, include a short runbook slide showing how a typical integration goes (API call flow + sample auth).

If you confirm the slot, I’ll send a calendar invite to lock it.

Best,
Elaine
Product Lead, NimbleHealth
elaine@nimblehealth.com
